faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about 1-2-3 Fuel and comparing fuel prices in Serbia.

q1.question: What is 1-2-3 Fuel?
q1.answer: 1-2-3 Fuel is Serbia's leading fuel price comparison platform. We help you find the cheapest petrol, diesel, and LPG prices across 500+ stations in Serbia, updated in real-time.

q2.question: How often are prices updated?
q2.answer: Our prices are updated every hour based on data from fuel stations across Serbia. We also rely on user reports to ensure accuracy.

q3.question: Is 1-2-3 Fuel free to use?
q3.answer: Yes! 1-2-3 Fuel is completely free for all users. You can compare prices, view the map, and use all features without any cost.

q4.question: How accurate are the fuel prices?
q4.answer: We strive for maximum accuracy by combining official station data with user reports. Prices are typically accurate within the last hour, but we recommend calling ahead for critical purchases.

q5.question: Why do prices vary between stations?
q5.answer: Fuel prices vary based on location, competition, brand pricing strategies, and local taxes. Stations in high-traffic areas or with less competition may have higher prices.

q6.question: Can I report incorrect prices?
q6.answer: Absolutely! If you notice a price discrepancy, please use our 'Report Price' feature or contact us. We verify all reports and update our database accordingly.

q7.question: Does 1-2-3 Fuel have a mobile app?
q7.answer: Our platform is fully responsive and works perfectly on any mobile device. We're also developing dedicated iOS and Android apps for an even better experience.

q8.question: How does the savings calculator work?
q8.answer: Our calculator compares the average fuel price in your area with the cheapest available station. It then calculates your potential savings based on how many liters you plan to fill.

q9.question: Do I need an account to use 1-2-3 Fuel?
q9.answer: No account is required for basic features like viewing prices and using the map. However, creating an account allows you to save favorite stations and receive price alerts.

q10.question: How can I save money on fuel?
q10.answer: The best way to save is to compare prices before filling up. Use our map to find the cheapest station near you, consider filling up during off-peak hours, and maintain your vehicle for better fuel efficiency.
